availability: 48h forecast cloud cover plus deterministic solar geometry, all known before origin cutoff.
aggregation: All24 hours required and present; mean cloud and mean positive-cosine-solar-elevation times1-cloud_fraction. This is a heuristic feature, not measured irradiance or calibrated PV production.
mechanism: Seasonal daylight modulated by forecast clouds captures weather-driven solar supply beyond day-of-year harmonics.
